filters.name: Current Mesh Info
filters.shortDescription: Prints a compact summary for the current mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Outputs vertex/edge/face counts and bounding-box metrics for the current mesh.

parameters.label: Decimal Precision
parameters.help: Number of decimals used when formatting bounding-box metrics.

filters.name: Normalize To Unit Box
filters.shortDescription: Uniformly scales the current mesh to a target box size.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Computes current mesh bounding box and applies uniform scale, with optional recentering.

parameters.label: Recenter
parameters.help: Recenters mesh to origin before scaling.

filters.name: Create Isosurface from Perlin Noise
filters.shortDescription: Creates an isosurface perturbed by 3D Perlin noise.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Generates a scalar field over a cubic grid and extracts an isosurface using marching cubes.

parameters.label: Resolution
parameters.help: Resolution of the side of the cubic grid used for volume creation.
